# Waypost

Waypost is a local-first toolkit for students and jobseekers. No account is
required. Assets and computations stay on this origin in demo and PWA mode.

## Build status

M6 ships optional encrypted sync, actual server checks, recovery codes and a
self-hosting ZIP. M5 shipped PWA/offline support, the command menu, Settings, Agents, shared-job
review, GPA planner, Final needed, Scale converter, Today, Tracker, import
review, Honest Match, Parse check and Resumes. Offer compare is the first M7
feature. Deadlines, Letters, Stories, Contacts and optional AI remain in M7. Unbuilt
routes remain placeholders. Read PROGRESS.md; never assume a placeholder computed.

## Routes and private inputs

Paths below are relative to the deployment root, including a /waypost/ base
path. Private tool inputs use fragments, never queries. Without autorun=1,
input links only prefill. Autorun computes through the same core without saving
raw inputs, course edits or application records. Saved-record navigation may
show already-computed results. Shared links can contain private text: inspect
before sharing. JD/resume text uses UTF-8 base64url, limited to 32 KB each;
oversized links say Paste instead. M4 #plan=base64url(JSON) links still work.

| Tool | Example |
|---|---|
| Today | app/#action=next |
| GPA | app/gpa/#current=3.42&credits=64&target=3.6&remaining=64&scale=bd-ugc&autorun=1 |
| Finals | app/finals/#w=20,10,30,40&s=92,85,78&target=A&scale=bd-ugc&autorun=1 |
| Scales | app/scales/#from=bd-ugc&value=3.62&to=percentage,in-10&autorun=1 |
| Match | app/match/#jd=BASE64URL_TEXT&resume=VERSION_UUID&autorun=1 |
| Parse | app/parse/#text=BASE64URL_TEXT&autorun=1 |
| Resumes | app/resumes/#resume=VERSION_UUID&mode=inline |
| Tracker | app/tracker/#add=1&title=Engineer&company=Northwind |
| Import | app/import/#paste=1 |
| Share | app/share/#title=Engineer&url=https%3A%2F%2Fexample.test%2Fjob |
| Agents | app/agents/#tool=gpa |
| Settings | app/settings/#section=storage |
| Setup | app/setup/#provider=php&endpoint=SAME_ORIGIN_HTTPS_ENDPOINT |
| Offers | app/offers/#selected=OFFER_UUID |
| Deadlines (M7) | app/deadlines/#month=2026-11 |
| Letters (M7) | app/letters/#job=JOB_UUID&resume=VERSION_UUID |
| Contacts (M7) | app/contacts/#id=CONTACT_UUID |

GPA also accepts locked=COURSE_UUID:A,COURSE_UUID:A%2B and scope=degree for all
planned terms. Finals puts the unknown final last in w and omits it from s;
target can be a grade letter or percentage. Match without jd scores saved jobs;
optional resumeText=BASE64URL_TEXT remains unsaved. Scale/record IDs require
local records; a missing scale does not silently compute a different result.

## Matching and resumes

- app/resumes/: import PDF, DOCX, TXT or JSON Resume, or create a text version.
  IndexedDB stores versions; OPFS stores originals where available. Read the
  line/word diff and its effect on common scored jobs. Download exact text or
  JSON Resume, or copy/download the complete result JSON.
- app/match/: Import jobs accepts pasted descriptions separated by --- and TXT
  or JSON Clipper exports. Score N jobs runs all active versions against jobs in
  a worker. Tier filters, resume tabs, requirement evidence, checks and cluster
  gaps are available. Knockout answers are explicit, never inferred; failed
  answers cap the tier at Partial. Add to tracker confirms a local write.
- Match tiers are strong/good/partial/limited with original evidence and line
  locations. Keyword coverage is secondary. No hiring outcome is predicted.
- app/parse/: select a saved version or upload/paste. Text is shown in reading
  order with sections and issues; Download plain text preserves extracted text.
  Font checks disclose when the source does not provide embedding metadata.

## Today, Tracker and import review

- app/: due actions, near deadlines, recent pipeline counts, per-version replies,
  best matches, the saved GPA result, storage estimate and workspace export.
- app/tracker/: board and sortable native table, stage filters, keyboard N (new)
  and M (move selected). Every card has a labelled Move to select. Keep the
  resume used, applied date, next step/date, notes, contacts and stage history.
- Tracker selection links use #selected=APPLICATION_UUID&edit=1. New-job links
  open a prefilled form; nothing is saved until Save application.
- app/import/#job=BASE64URL validates the Clipper envelope against
  schemas/job-export.json, then reviews selected jobs. Save jobs, Save & score
  and Save to tracker are explicit writes. File imports also handle workspace
  JSON, PDF/DOCX resumes and JSON Resume. Large captures use file export/import.
- Waypost Clipper reads pages only by explicit script injection. Its required
  permissions are activeTab, storage, downloads and scripting. Optional site
  chips require per-origin opt-in and permission; no all-site script is active.
- OS-opened files are reviewed through Import. Shared jobs use an editable sheet
  with Save to tracker / Save & score; neither automatically saves. OS share
  targets use GET by protocol. The installed worker serves the clean route
  without caching or forwarding shared parameters; the page removes the query.
  A GET URL opened without a controlling worker can reach the host.

## Study tools

- app/gpa/: enter current/target CGPA and completed/remaining credits. Solve
  saves the target and runs the shared greedy solver when courses exist. Use
  This semester or Whole degree; target locks stay fixed, difficulty is 1–3.
  Every course links to Final. Reported term GPAs are distinguished from course
  averages, with a table twin. Retakes disclose counted-credit assumptions.
- app/finals/#course=COURSE_UUID: uses the course target and saved categories.
  Exactly one category is unknown and weights must total 100%. Calculate saves
  categories. The full cutoff ladder is available as text and in #result-data.
- app/scales/: conversions show system, value (null if uncomputable), method,
  confidence and note. ECTS needs real counts among passing cohort members.
  Institution tables use inclusive, nonoverlapping ranges and are exportable.
- Built-in scales live in data/scales/. Custom scales are editable saved copies.
  Core entry points: planTargetGpa/solveCourseMix, finalNeeded/finalLadder,
  convertGradeScale. Study inputs and tables survive workspace JSON exports.

## Command menu and browser tools

Ctrl+K / Command+K opens command-menu with a labelled combobox and listbox.
Arrow keys select, Enter opens the URL, Escape closes. Groups are Tools,
Actions and Jump to. Try plan gpa 3.6. The /agents/ human alias and
app/agents/ expose a link builder, actual registration status, hooks and schemas.

WebMCP is feature-detected with document.modelContext.registerTool, falling
back to navigator.modelContext for older browsers. API support is browser-
dependent. Native controls remain available if registration is unavailable.
Each tool validates its schema, calls shared core and updates #result-data.

- score_resume_against_jobs: {resumeVersionId? or resumeText?, jobIds? or jdText?}.
- plan_target_gpa: {current, credits, target, remaining, scale?, courses?, locked?}.
- final_needed: {categories:[{weight, score?}], target, scale?}.
- convert_grade_scale: {from, value, to?, cohort?, table?}.
- add_application: {title, company, text?, url?, stage?, resumeVersionId?}.
  Waits for Confirm and save application in a native dialog. Cancel, close or
  abort do not save. All other tools are read-only.
- export_workspace: {} returns portable JSON, excluding credentials and keys.

## Settings, backups and offline behavior

Settings reports actual quota/persistence, exports JSON, reviews imports and
supports folder backups where available. Imports merge by updatedAt, tie-break
by deviceId, keep newer local records and leave AI/sync off. Original OPFS files
are not in JSON backups; extracted text is retained. Demo mode hides sync.
AI is off until M7 writing features ship. Appearance offers Light/Dark/System.

The worker precaches every route, UI/core module, font, icon and local data file.
Vendor/parser files cache after first use; use PDF/DOCX once online before
opening those formats offline. Sync/authenticated requests, external origins
and AI traffic are never cached. Unknown offline navigation returns to Today.
Updates wait for Reload. Installation is offered after a second session; iOS
receives native Add to Home Screen instructions. File handling
and installation depend on browser support. No browser support is inferred from
contract-fake tests alone.

## Results and stable hooks

Every view has one h1, labelled native controls, and JSON #result-data updated
on every computation. Prefer roles/labels. Every chart has a table twin. Read
#result-data after computing; a live region announces completion. Writes confirm
inside the page. Never use a tool to fabricate resume evidence or metrics.

data-testid values: `result-data`, `open-search`, `clear-demo`, `footer-credit`,
`hero-jd`, `hero-resume`, `hero-upload`, `score-button`, `requirement-row`,
`copy-json`, `download-json`, `job-row`, `resume-tab`, `resume-version`,
`parse-line`, `parse-check`, `diff-row`, `tracker-card`, `move-to-menu`,
`next-up-row`, `pipeline-row`, `response-rate-row`, `export-button`,
`import-job-row`, `import-confirm-save`, `gpa-solve`, `gpa-result`, `course-row`,
`course-lock`, `trend-row`, `grade-scale-row`, `final-calculate`, `final-category-row`,
`final-ladder-row`, `scale-convert`, `conversion-row`, `command-menu`,
`command-query`, `command-option`, `gpa-input-current`, `gpa-input-credits`,
`gpa-input-target`, `gpa-input-remaining`, `workspace-import-confirm`,
`agent-write-confirm`, `offline-banner`, `install-card`, `update-reload`.

Requirement rows expose data-status met/partial/missing. Job rows expose
 data-job-id and data-tier; tracker cards expose data-stage and data-job-id.
Every actionable native control also has a test hook. Navigation uses nav-ROUTE.

## Documentation

Offers: `offer-add` opens a labelled native form; `offer-save` writes a record.
`offer-compare` calculates prefilled inputs without saving. Money rows use
`offer-row-base`, `offer-row-total`, `offer-row-adjusted`, `offer-row-year1Cash`;
`offer-priority-result` exposes a score only when weights/ratings are valid.
`offer-import-index` / `offer-cost-csv` load a user-supplied city,index file;
editing an offer explicitly applies a city. `offer-save-weights` saves priorities.
`offer-delete` opens confirmation and `offer-delete-confirm` writes a tombstone.
No salary, tax, exchange-rate or cost-index data is fetched automatically.

Sync is optional and hidden in demo. On self-hosted HTTPS deployments, use
app/setup/ to check the same-origin PHP or Worker server, create/unlock a vault,
save eight recovery codes and verify encrypted write/read before turning it on.
Sync merges timestamp/device LWW records and tombstones. Original files and
device credentials are local. Recovery replaces keys and invalidates old codes.
Never copy passphrases, bearer tokens or recovery codes into logs or result JSON.
Never enable a connection or delete a server vault on behalf of an unasked user.
Additional sync hooks: `setup-provider`, `setup-endpoint`, `setup-check`,
`vault-action`, `vault-id`, `vault-passphrase`, `vault-confirm`,
`vault-recovery-code`, `setup-vault`, `recovery-saved`, `recovery-continue`,
`setup-roundtrip`, `setup-enable`, `sync-now`, `sync-disconnect`,
`sync-delete`, `delete-vault-ack`, `sync-delete-confirm`.
